recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No core follow-up is needed for FHIR-13518 unless PA separately wants a broad editorial standardization of active search-parameter descriptions.
issue_request: FHIR-13518 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 PA change request reporting that Organization.active incorrectly used the generic Address search description and requesting an active-flag description while assigning the Address text to Organization.address.
initial_application: No current git commit explicitly mentions FHIR-13518. The archived STU3 generated search-parameters bundle still shows the reported wrong active description, but the current source refactored in 2021 already describes Organization-active as 'Is the Organization record active' and Organization-address with the generic Address string-field text.
additional_context: Organization is active in source/fhir.ini, so source/organization/bundle-Organization-search-params.xml is in current build scope. A later FHIR-29034 Organization change moved address search expressions from Organization.address to Organization.contact.address while preserving the correct Address description. The current active wording is not the exact Jira sentence, but it conveys the intended boolean/token active search semantics and matches the style of neighboring active search parameters.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The current authoritative source no longer has the swapped Address description on Organization.active, and editing historical generated release files or making a purely redundant wording change would not improve the current specification.
